verdicts.reason: A reflows the two-line headline onto one line, which suits the strip, and keeps the bold serif at a size that fills the height with even margins, so the original's punchy feel survives; at most it could sit a touch larger. B uses the same one-line layout but shrinks the type so far that it floats small in a lot of dead space, which weakens the only focal element and drains the impact of this text-only design.
